text:
Model	STI-210GE
Product Name	12 port 10/100/1000Mbps Industrial Ethernet Switch
Fixed Port	8*10/100/1000M RJ45 port / 2*10/100/1000M Uplink RJ45 port / 2*1000M SFP
Bandwidth	24Gbps
Packet Forwarding	17.86Mpps
MAC	2K
Buffer	2.5M
Transmission Distance	10BASE-T: Cat3,4,5 UTP(≤250 meter) / 100BASE-TX: Cat5 or later UTP(150 meter) / 1000BASE-TX: Cat6 or later UTP(150 meter)
Optical Media	SFP: 1000M single and multimode optical module, Max distance≤100Km
LED Indicator	PWR: Power indicator (green) / EX Max: power overload indicator (green) / Port: green _10/100M network connection indicator / green+orange _1000M network connection indicator. / 9-10: Optical fiber connection indicator (green) / P1: Main power indicator (green) / P2: slave power indicator (green)
Power	Three groups of independent power input / SW: DC 12-57V
Operating Temperature / Humidity	-40°C～+75°C / 10%～90% RH No condensation
Storage Temperature / Humidity	-40°C～+85°C / 5%～95% RH No condensation
Dimension / L*W*H	Device: 160mm*130mm*45mm / Packing Box: 280mm*165mm*79mm
N.W/G.W(Kg)	1.3Kg/1.5Kg
Lightning / Protection Level	6KV 8/20us; 8KV ESD electrostatic protection / IP40
Installation	Desktop, Wall, Rack mountable(with mounting hangers)
Warranty	3 Years
Power	Three groups of independent power input / SW: DC 12-57V
